name: org.ecosar.starter.web.LiveEdgeOrchestratorService
comment:
Live Hardware & Runtime Orchestrator Service for the EcoSAR Edge Gateway.

Connects the EcoSAR Core (Thompson Sampling Fast-Loop + MRGP Slow-Loop) and Linux Platform adapters (NativeSmapsRollupReader, LinuxCpufreqActuator) to the physical edge node:

  • Reads real /proc/[pid]/smaps_rollup from the active Ollama runner subprocess
  • Reads real 1 Hz wall-plug power from Tapo P115 CSV stream and CPU package temp from sysfs/sensors
  • Computes the authentic REN Portugal 24-hour diurnal carbon intensity signal CI(t)
  • Executes autonomous Slow-Loop MRGP inspections and Tier 1 / Tier 2 rejuvenation actions

methods.name: selectAndActuateOperatingPoint
methods.comment: Selects the active OperatingPoint for the upcoming inference request (Fast-Loop) and applies hardware/OS-level actuation without restarting the Ollama runner process.

methods.name: resolveThreadsForOperatingPoint
methods.comment: Keeps Ollama runner thread count constant (8) matching the 8 E-core / P-core topology of the Intel Core i5-13500 so Ollama never restarts the llama.cpp runner process on Fast-Loop transitions and never suffers ggml_barrier spin-wait oversubscription.

methods.name: recordInferenceFeedback
methods.comment: Records post-inference feedback into the Fast-Loop Thompson Sampling bandit and updates live TPS.

methods.name: getCurrentGridSignal
methods.comment: Computes the current REN Portugal diurnal grid carbon signal CI(t) with smooth cosine interpolation.

methods.name: sampleLiveTelemetry
methods.comment: Collects a live multi-modal TelemetrySample from the Linux kernel (/proc/[pid]/smaps_rollup), CPU thermal sensors, and the 1 Hz Tapo P115 wattmeter CSV stream.

methods.name: runScheduledInspection
methods.comment: Autonomous Slow-Loop MRGP inspection & rejuvenation triage.

methods.name: executeRealTier1Flush
methods.comment: Executes a real Tier 1 KV/Context Flush on the local Ollama engine.

methods.name: executeRealTier2WarmReload
methods.comment:
Executes a 4-stage choreographed Tier 2 User-Space Process Warm Reload on the local Ollama engine:
  1. Admission cordon via {@link ResilientServingQueue#pauseForRejuvenation()}
  2. In-flight quiescence drain via {@link ResilientServingQueue#awaitInFlightQuiescence(Duration)}
  3. Process unload ({@code keep_alive: 0}) and warm weight reload into a fresh runner PID
  4. Queue resumption & buffered replay via {@link ResilientServingQueue#resumeAfterRejuvenation()}

methods.name: readTailLines
methods.comment: Reads only the trailing maxBytes of a growing telemetry CSV in O(1) memory, preventing unbounded heap allocations as 24h-48h logs accumulate.
